$comment: Single source of truth for the tauri-ffi C ABI. bindings/bindgen/generate.mjs renders the C header, koffi declarations, Deno symbols and Python cffi cdef from this file, and cross-checks it against the extern fns in src/. Param types: handle (u64 id), str (borrowed UTF-8 in), owned_str (ownership transferred back, e.g. tauri_string_free), bytes (borrowed byte buffer; may be NULL where documented), bool, u32, i32, f64, out_handle, out_bool, out_u32, out_u64, out_i32, out_f64, out_owned_str (caller frees via tauri_string_free). Results: status (i32 error code), u32, borrowed_str (do not free), void. thread: 'any' | 'main' (the thread that builds/runs the loop). blocking: call blocks the calling thread (dynamic FFI hosts should use async/nonblocking call modes). platforms: the targets the function actually works on — the symbol is exported on every platform (the ABI never varies across targets), but calling it elsewhere returns ERR_UNSUPPORTED without side effects.

errors.name: ERR_TIMEOUT
errors.doc: tauri_events_next timed out with no message.

errors.name: ERR_CLOSED
errors.doc: The app has shut down; no more messages.

errors.name: ERR_INVALID_ARG
errors.doc: Null pointer, invalid UTF-8 or malformed JSON argument.

errors.name: ERR_UNSUPPORTED
errors.doc: The function is not supported on the current platform (see its `platforms` contract).

errors.name: ERR_PANIC
errors.doc: Rust panic caught at the FFI boundary.

errors.name: ERR_NOT_FOUND
errors.doc: No object with the requested label/name.

functions.name: tauri_ffi_version
functions.doc: Semver of the tauri-ffi crate. Borrowed static string, do not free.

functions.name: tauri_ffi_abi_version
functions.doc: Monotonic ABI version; bumped on breaking changes.

functions.name: tauri_last_error_message
functions.doc: Message for the last error on this thread, or NULL. Borrowed pointer, valid until the next failing call on the same thread.

functions.name: tauri_string_free
functions.doc: Releases a string returned through a char** out param.

functions.name: tauri_handle_close
functions.doc: Drops any handle (builder, app, window, resolver). Closing a window handle does not affect the window itself.

functions.name: tauri_app_builder_new
functions.doc: Creates an app builder from a tauri.conf.json-shaped JSON string (unknown fields rejected).

functions.name: tauri_app_builder_set_assets_dir
functions.doc: Serves `WebviewUrl::App` paths (e.g. "index.html") from this directory.

functions.name: tauri_app_builder_set_assets_archive
functions.doc: Serves `WebviewUrl::App` paths from a tauri-ffi assets archive (created by `tauri build` for bindings projects). Takes precedence over tauri_app_builder_set_assets_dir.

functions.name: tauri_app_builder_set_dev
functions.doc: Enables dev mode: `WebviewUrl::App` windows load from the config's `build.devUrl` (when set) instead of the bundled assets, mirroring a Rust dev build. The Tauri CLI sets TAURI_DEV=true when running bindings projects; language bindings translate it into this call.

functions.name: tauri_app_builder_register_command
functions.doc: Registers a command name; its invokes arrive on the event queue as {"type":"invoke","id":<resolver>,"command":...,"payload":...,"webview":...}.

functions.name: tauri_app_builder_add_capability
functions.doc: Adds a capability (JSON or TOML string, capability file format). If none is added, a default granting core:default to all windows is applied.

functions.name: tauri_plugin_new
functions.doc: Creates a plugin definition with the given name. Plugin commands are invoked from the frontend as `plugin:<name>|<command>`; their invokes arrive on the event queue with an extra `"plugin"` field. `core` and `tauri` are reserved names. Attach with tauri_app_builder_add_plugin.

functions.name: tauri_plugin_set_init_script
functions.doc: Sets JavaScript injected into every webview before page scripts run (wrapped in its own function scope — assign globals to `window`). Overrides any previously set script.

functions.name: tauri_plugin_register_command
functions.doc: Registers a command handled by this plugin. The default capability grants every registered plugin command to all windows.

functions.name: tauri_app_builder_add_plugin
functions.doc: Attaches a plugin to the builder, consuming the plugin handle. Its permissions are synthesized into the ACL so its commands resolve at runtime.

functions.name: tauri_app_build
functions.doc: Consumes the builder and builds the app. Windows declared in the config are created when the app runs.

functions.name: tauri_app_run
functions.doc: Runs the event loop until the app exits; out_exit_code receives the requested exit code. Must be called on the thread that called tauri_app_build. Run events are also delivered through the event queue.

functions.name: tauri_app_exit
functions.doc: Requests app exit from any thread.

functions.name: tauri_events_next
functions.doc: Waits up to timeout_ms for the next queued message (run events, subscribed events, invokes). On OK, *out_json is an owned JSON string — free with tauri_string_free. Returns ERR_TIMEOUT on timeout and ERR_CLOSED after shutdown. Message types: {"type":"ready"} | {"type":"exit"} | {"type":"exit-requested","code":N} | {"type":"window-event","label":L,"event":{"kind":...}} | {"type":"event","event":E,"id":N,"payload":...} | {"type":"invoke","id":R,"command":C,"payload":...,"webview":L}

functions.name: tauri_app_emit
functions.doc: Emits an event to all listeners (Rust, frontend and FFI subscribers). payload_json must be valid JSON.

functions.name: tauri_app_emit_to
functions.doc: Emits an event to every target with the given label.

functions.name: tauri_app_listen
functions.doc: Subscribes to an event (any target). Deliveries arrive on the event queue as {"type":"event","event":...,"id":...,"payload":...}.

functions.name: tauri_app_unlisten
functions.doc: Removes an event subscription.

functions.name: tauri_invoke_resolve
functions.doc: Resolves a pending invoke with a JSON value. Consumes the resolver handle. Callable from any thread, any time after the invoke was delivered.

functions.name: tauri_invoke_reject
functions.doc: Rejects a pending invoke with a JSON value. Consumes the resolver handle.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_create
functions.doc: Creates a webview window from a WindowConfig JSON object (same shape as entries of app.windows in tauri.conf.json). Blocks until the running event loop has created the window — call only while the app runs (e.g. after the ready event). On OK, *out_window is a window handle; release with tauri_handle_close.

functions.name: tauri_app_get_webview_window
functions.doc: Looks up the webview window with the given label. Returns ERR_NOT_FOUND if no such window exists. On OK, *out_window is a window handle; release with tauri_handle_close.

functions.doc: Moves the window. physical=true interprets x/y as physical pixels, otherwise as logical (DPI-scaled) pixels.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_decorations
functions.doc: Shows or hides the window decorations (title bar, borders).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_focus

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_zoom
functions.doc: Sets the webview zoom level (1.0 = 100%).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_show
functions.doc: Makes the window visible.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_hide
functions.doc: Hides the window.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_center

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_maximize
functions.doc: Maximizes the window.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_unmaximize
functions.doc: Restores the window from the maximized state.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_minimize
functions.doc: Minimizes the window.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_unminimize
functions.doc: Restores the window from the minimized state.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_close
functions.doc: Requests the window to close (triggers close-requested handling). The window handle stays valid until released with tauri_handle_close.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_destroy
functions.doc: Destroys the window unconditionally (no close-requested event). The window handle stays valid until released with tauri_handle_close.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_eval
functions.doc: Evaluates JavaScript in the window's webview.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_navigate
functions.doc: Navigates the webview to the given URL.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_reload
functions.doc: Reloads the webview's current page.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_is_decorated
functions.doc: Whether the window has decorations (title bar, borders).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_is_closable
functions.doc: Whether the window's native close button is enabled.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_is_maximizable
functions.doc: Whether the window's native maximize button is enabled.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_is_minimizable
functions.doc: Whether the window's native minimize button is enabled.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_is_always_on_top
functions.doc: Whether the window is set to always stay above other windows.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_is_enabled
functions.doc: Whether the window is enabled (accepts user input).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_is_menu_visible
functions.doc: Whether the window menu is currently visible. Unsupported on macOS.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_is_devtools_open
functions.doc: Whether the webview devtools window is open. Requires a debug build or the tauri-ffi `devtools` feature; otherwise fails.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_theme
functions.doc: The window's current theme ("light" or "dark"), as an owned string.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_closable
functions.doc: Enables or disables the window's native close button.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_maximizable
functions.doc: Enables or disables the window's native maximize button.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_minimizable
functions.doc: Enables or disables the window's native minimize button.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_always_on_bottom
functions.doc: Keeps the window below all other windows, or stops doing so.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_content_protected
functions.doc: Prevents the window content from being captured by other apps (screenshots, screen recording).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_skip_taskbar
functions.doc: Whether to keep the window out of the taskbar / dock.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_shadow
functions.doc: Enables or disables the window shadow.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_visible_on_all_workspaces
functions.doc: Whether the window is shown on all workspaces / virtual desktops.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_ignore_cursor_events
functions.doc: When enabled, the window ignores mouse events and passes them to windows underneath.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_cursor_visible
functions.doc: Shows or hides the cursor over the window.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_cursor_grab
functions.doc: Grabs or releases the cursor, confining it to the window when grabbed.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_enabled
functions.doc: Enables or disables the window (whether it accepts user input).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_focusable
functions.doc: Whether the window can receive focus.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_simple_fullscreen
functions.doc: Enters or leaves simple fullscreen mode. On macOS uses native simple fullscreen; other platforms fall back to regular fullscreen.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_min_size
functions.doc: Sets the window's minimum size. physical=true interprets width/height as physical pixels, otherwise as logical (DPI-scaled) pixels. width<=0 or height<=0 clears the constraint.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_max_size
functions.doc: Sets the window's maximum size. physical=true interprets width/height as physical pixels, otherwise as logical (DPI-scaled) pixels. width<=0 or height<=0 clears the constraint.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_cursor_position
functions.doc: Moves the cursor to the given position, relative to the window's top-left corner. physical=true interprets x/y as physical pixels, otherwise as logical (DPI-scaled) pixels.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_theme
functions.doc: Sets the window theme. Pass "light" or "dark"; an empty string follows the system theme.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_cursor_icon
functions.doc: Sets the cursor icon (e.g. "default", "pointer", "crosshair", "grab", "wait"; unknown names fall back to the default).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_request_user_attention
functions.doc: Requests the user's attention on the window. Pass "critical" or "informational"; an empty string cancels the request.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_progress_bar
functions.doc: Sets the taskbar/dock progress bar from a ProgressBarState JSON object, e.g. {"status":"normal","progress":42}.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_effects
functions.doc: Applies window effects from a WindowEffectsConfig JSON object (requires a transparent window). Pass "null" or an empty string to clear effects.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_size_constraints
functions.doc: Sets the window size constraints from a WindowSizeConstraints JSON object, e.g. {"minWidth":{"Logical":400}}.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_background_color
functions.doc: Sets the window background color. Each channel is 0-255 (values above 255 are clamped).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_badge_count
functions.doc: Sets the app badge count shown on this window's taskbar/dock icon. A negative count clears the badge. Unsupported on Windows (use a badge label).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_badge_label
functions.doc: Sets the badge label shown on the app's dock icon. An empty string clears the label.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_title_bar_style
functions.doc: Sets the title bar style. Pass "visible", "transparent" or "overlay".

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_set_overlay_icon
functions.doc: Sets the taskbar overlay icon from RGBA pixel data (width*height*4 bytes). Pass NULL rgba to clear it.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_ns_window
functions.doc: The NSWindow pointer backing the window, as an integer.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_ns_view
functions.doc: The NSView pointer backing the window's content view, as an integer.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_hwnd
functions.doc: The window's HWND, as an integer.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_start_dragging
functions.doc: Starts dragging the window (call from a mouse-down handler).

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_print
functions.doc: Opens the print dialog for the webview.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_clear_all_browsing_data
functions.doc: Clears all browsing data (cookies, storage, cache) for this webview.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_hide_menu
functions.doc: Hides the window menu. Unsupported on macOS.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_show_menu
functions.doc: Shows the window menu. Unsupported on macOS.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_open_devtools
functions.doc: Opens the webview devtools window. Requires a debug build or the tauri-ffi `devtools` feature; otherwise fails.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_close_devtools
functions.doc: Closes the webview devtools window. Requires a debug build or the tauri-ffi `devtools` feature; otherwise fails.

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_available_monitors

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_monitor_from_point

functions.name: tauri_webview_window_cursor_position

functions.name: tauri_app_path
functions.doc: Resolves a platform base directory by name (Manager::path). kind mirrors the PathResolver methods in camelCase: appConfig, appData, appLocalData, appCache, appLog, audio, cache, config, data, localData, desktop, document, download, executable, font, home, picture, public, resource, runtime, template, video, temp. On OK, *out_path is an owned path string.

functions.name: tauri_app_once
